samples.label: A22. Deaths in fires in blocks of flats by sex, age group, house type, area of origin, fire cause, smoke detector activation and year
samples.source: Swedish Civil Defence and Resilience Agency
note:
Statistics on deaths within 30 days of a fire due to burns or smoke inhalation, as assessed by the Swedish Civil Defence and Resilience Agency on the basis of information from the municipal fire and rescue service, the police, the Swedish Transport Administration, the National Forensic Centre (1999-2015) and the national burns centres in Linköping and Uppsala.

Institutional forms of accommodation such as sheltered housing, care homes, nursing homes, communal housing and student residences are not included in this category.
